description: Original dark fantasy pixel art for a ruined magical academy RPG. Crisp pixel clusters, limited desaturated blue gray stone and weathered bronze palette, upper-left lighting, thin dark outline, readable at native resolution. No text, no letters, no watermark. Game UI decorative component sheet: small mouse pointer and crosshair reticle plus boss bar frame and restrained pause screen border accents. Each piece isolated with spacing, simple rectangular geometry, no words or numbers.
